# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/dependencies

List issues that block the given issue (its dependencies)

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-208`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| index | path | integer | True |
| page | query | integer | False |
| limit | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — []*api.Issue

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | issue ID |
| `index` | int64 | issue index in repo |
| `title` | string | issue title |
| `state` | string | open/closed |
| `repo` | RepositoryMeta | repository metadata |

- **404** — Dependencies disabled on repo, issue not found, or no read permission

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.GetIssueDependencies | controller | Check dependencies enabled on repo; Get issue by index; Check read permission |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | Repository.IsDependenciesEnabled | service | Get repo unit TypeIssues; Return IssuesConfig().EnableDependencies or default |
| 3 | [models](../modules/models.md) | issues_model.GetIssueByIndex | repository | Query issue by repo_id and index |

| 5 | [models](../modules/models.md) | access_model.GetDoerRepoPermission | service | Get permission for each unique repo (cached in map) |
| 6 | [services](../modules/services.md) | convert.ToAPIIssueList | utility | Convert each issue to API format, loading labels/assignees/milestone |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Dependencies must be enabled on the repository for listing dependencies | validation | !ctx.Repo.Repository.IsDependenciesEnabled(ctx) |
| User must have read permission on the issue type (issues or pulls) to view dependencies | authorization | !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanReadIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |
| Blockers from repos user cannot read are hidden (HIDDEN title) or shown with limited info (if user can write to the issue) | authorization | !perm.CanReadIssuesOrPulls(blocker.Issue.IsPull) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| IsDependenciesEnabled returns false | 404 | notFound | False |
| Issue index not found | 404 | notFound | False |
| Cannot read issues/pulls | 404 | notFound | False |

### Error Paths

- **Dependencies disabled on repo** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **Issue not found** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **No read permission on issue** → ctx.APIErrorNotFound → 404
- **DB error** → ctx.APIErrorInternal → 500
